description: A floor-length deep blue Sturgian wool gown over an opaque cream linen shift, with a low square neckline, naturally fitted bodice and elbow sleeves. Tan-gold geometric woven borders frame the neckline, waist, cuffs, front and hem. A round decorative bronze brooch sits at the waist. A cream patterned shoulder wrap rests along her arms, and a modest front opening reveals the underlayer and dark brown shoes.
